Start · lights out and away we go

Standing start from the grid behind the line; the race clock starts at lights-out (5 reds, one per second, then a random hold). Grid: Blue 41, Red 7, Red 17, Grey 91, Blue 14, White 8, Black 88, White 33, Black 98, Silver 19. Lap 1 arrivals were bunched within ~2 s.

How this race was made

Grid of five look-alike pairs: Red 7 / Red 17 (same body and paint, only the number differs), Black 88 / Black 98 (same body, other sticker colours), White 33 / White 8 (other stripe), Blue 14 / Blue 41 (other body), Silver 19 / Grey 91 (a shade darker). Cars rendered once as car + shadow and laid onto a rendered dirt road (earth, small stones, tyre ruts, grass verges). Pairs whose calibration pictures are at least 88 % alike are sorted by the twin solver: the whole race at once, each crossing to the car whose lap rhythm it fits; a crossing it can’t settle becomes a Check card, and for a pair that looks the same the app asks once which is which.

The ten new minis (GT3, LMP, Formula, rally, touring, drift, Group 5, supercar, stock car, hypercar; 15–19.5 cm, wear and stickers), each rendered alone from 1.8 m straight above (480×270, Cycles, 1/120 s blur): two calibration passes, four lanes, a fast pass and two diagonal crossings (+25°, −38°) per car. Passes composited onto the empty track with sensor noise: standing start from lights-out, 10 laps, per-car pace 17.6–18.6 s ±0.3 s, spins, a forced photo finish (1 frame apart, abreast, lap 4) and a three-wide arrival (lap 7). Diagonal crossings only when no other car is near (cars can't pass through each other in a composite).

Engine (this branch): nose timing (blob edge ahead of the centroid, minus the mask rim and half the blur streak), crossing box + velocity on every event; LapIdentity after the camera: conflicts, unnamed crossings, check-line rescues and missing laps decided by each car's lap rhythm. Decisions: twin unsure 7, not counted 7, twin which 2, twin timing 91.

Pace: Black 88 17.74, Black 98 18.48, Blue 14 18.47, Blue 41 18.56, Grey 91 17.67, Red 17 17.91, Red 7 18.40, Silver 19 18.33, White 33 17.71, White 8 18.06 s. Spins: Black 88 lap 7: +4.2 s (spin), White 33 lap 2: +4.1 s (spin).
